## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The containment check in `preview` must be fixed before merge: it accepts `..` segments, so the helper reads files outside the home directory. The added test, which this review read but did not run, exercises only an absolute outside path.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview(home, relative)`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under a home directory, and `settings_file(home)`, which returns the `settings.toml` path. It also adds tests for both helpers and a text file, `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the outside-home check in `preview` — `preview(home, "../outside.txt")` returns the first 200 characters of a file outside `home` instead of raising `ValueError`. `Path.is_relative_to` compares components lexically, so `home/../outside.txt` passes; the only rejection case in `test_preview` is an absolute path (tests/test_paths.py:20). — A caller that passes a user-chosen relative path can read any file the process can read, which defeats the containment check. — Fix: Check `Path(home, relative).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(home).resolve())`, which also rejects symlinks that leave home, and extend `test_preview` with a `..` case.

(none)

## Suggestions
- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — Separate undecodable-file errors from the outside-home error — `preview(home, "photo.png")` on a file that is not valid text raises `UnicodeDecodeError`, a subclass of the `ValueError` that line 13 raises for "outside home". `read_text()` decodes the whole file with no error handling before slicing. — A caller that catches `ValueError` to reject outside paths misreports a binary file inside home as outside home. — Fix: Either raise a dedicated exception for the containment failure or decode with `errors="replace"`, depending on whether binary files should produce a preview.
